I visited this bowling place today and had a great experience. The venue is well-maintained and has four bowling lanes along with other fun activities like VR games, air hockey, and laser tag. It's a fantastic place to spend quality time …

It's a great place to kill some time in Bangalore. I'm not entirely sure if the experience was worth the price, but we still had fun. We tried bowling, their LED game floor, and a VR game. The staff are friendly, helpful, and take the time to explain how each game works.
